source.title: WCA Regulations – January 2025
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee would like to inform you about a new version of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines. This version will be in effect for competitions beginning on, or after, January 1st, 2025. <!-- break -->

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2024-01-01...official-2025-01-01-fixed). You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulations and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are marked red.

You can read a more detailed description of changes in this [explainer document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q0XkRuSz-Nxy9BFcXSkzNLLl6D7u3_2VHhU_w_Pokyw/edit?usp=sharing). Below is a summary of the changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines.

Major Changes:

* Define frame-by-frame analysis requirements [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1268)
* Introduce a defined process for handling misscrambles [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1266)
* Allow logos for 3x3x3 Blindfolded [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1265)
* Increase leniency for grading 3x3x3 Fewest Moves [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1264)
* Allow championships to restrict advancement to competitors from the relevant region [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1263)

Minor Changes:

* Remove the 2e2 restriction on country changes [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1262)
* Allow for retroactive scorecard signing by inexperienced competitors [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1261)
* Change 9f2 from rounding to truncation [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1259)
* Requirements for placing the sight blocker [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1257)
* Rearrange Clock-specific Regulations [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1255)
* Don’t retroactively punish visible camera screens [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1254)
* Clarify fixing multiple corner twists [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1253)
* Add discretion to Regulation A6b [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1252)
* Add scramble secrecy requirements to the Regulations [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1251)
* Clarify Regulation 5b5f [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1250)
* Prevent A6c from triggering A6e [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1249)
* Define invalid attempt [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1248)
* Required signature standards [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1247)
* Don't allow scorecards to be defaced [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1246)
* Permit the competitor to stop a stopwatch if no judge is available [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1244)
* More clearly separate scrambler/judge and competitor roles [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1243)
* Remove Guideline 9b+ [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1242)
* Permit external microphones [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1241)
* Extend 2g3 exemption to 3x3x3 Multi-Blind [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1240)
* Clarify A3d [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1239)
* DNF penalty for competitors knocking over the cube cover [changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1238)

translation.title: WCA 竞赛规则更新（2025 年 1 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会在此通知，新版《WCA 竞赛规则与指南》将适用于 2025 年 1 月 1 日及之后开始的比赛。

所有改动可在 [GitHub 版本对比](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2024-01-01...official-2025-01-01-fixed)中查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看规则与指南的完整文件，其中新增和修改的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

更详细的说明见这份[改动说明文档](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q0XkRuSz-Nxy9BFcXSkzNLLl6D7u3_2VHhU_w_Pokyw/edit?usp=sharing)。以下是新版规则与指南的改动概要。

主要改动：

* 明确逐帧分析的要求 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1268)
* 引入处理错误打乱的明确流程 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1266)
* 允许三阶盲拧使用带标识的魔方 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1265)
* 放宽三阶最少步的判卷标准 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1264)
* 允许锦标赛将晋级资格限于相关地区的选手 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1263)

次要改动：

* 取消规则 2e2 对更改代表国家的限制 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1262)
* 允许缺乏经验的选手事后补签成绩单 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1261)
* 将规则 9f2 的四舍五入改为截断 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1259)
* 明确遮挡板的放置要求 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1257)
* 重新编排魔表相关规则 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1255)
* 不因相机屏幕可见而事后追罚 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1254)
* 明确多个角块扭转的修复方式 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1253)
* 允许对规则 A6b 酌情处理 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1252)
* 将打乱保密要求加入规则 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1251)
* 明确规则 5b5f [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1250)
* 避免规则 A6c 同时触发规则 A6e [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1249)
* 定义无效还原 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1248)
* 明确签名要求 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1247)
* 禁止涂损成绩单 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1246)
* 允许选手在没有裁判时自行停止秒表 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1244)
* 进一步明确区分打乱员、裁判与选手的身份 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1243)
* 删除指南 9b+ [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1242)
* 允许使用外接麦克风 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1241)
* 将规则 2g3 的例外扩展至三阶多盲 [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1240)
* 明确规则 A3d [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1239)
* 选手碰倒魔方罩时判罚 DNF [改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1238)
